result.summary: Found 1 major issue: a data rendering bug showing '€NaN delivery' for one restaurant, indicating an invalid or missing numeric value being displayed to the user.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid price, exposing an unformatted NaN (not-a-number) value to the user.
issues.suggestion: Fix the data source or fallback logic so the delivery fee renders as a valid price (e.g., '€0.90 delivery' or 'Free delivery') when the value is missing or not a number.
